checklist.item: Lint and typecheck. Every finding of the repository's own lint (biome, SonarJS) and typecheck (tsc) scripts on main.
checklist.evidence: No package.json, no lint or typecheck script, no tsconfig.json and no source file. In an rsync copy: `timeout 600 npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` exit 254 (ENOENT package.json); `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck` exit 1 (Script not found); `bunx --no-install tsc --noEmit` (TypeScript 7.0.2 from the runner, no project) prints its usage, exit 1. The planned Rust tools have no manifest either: `cargo clippy` exit 101 and `cargo fmt --check` exit 1 (could not find Cargo.toml). `git ls-files | grep -E '\.(rs|ts|js|mjs|toml|json|ya?ml|sh)$'`: no output, exit 1.

checklist.item: Complexity. The functions with the highest cognitive complexity, with their value against the budget of the shared configuration.
checklist.evidence: No functions. The shared budget is sonarjs/cognitive-complexity 15 (pulse-config eslint.config.js:16, config 88996cb) and covers TypeScript and JavaScript (eslint.config.js:11). pulse-config has no Rust configuration: `grep -rnwiE "rust|cargo|clippy|rustfmt" .repos/config --exclude-dir=.git` finds nothing, exit 1 (note N3).

checklist.item: Duplicated logic. Logic that two or more files of this repository, or this repository and another pulse repository, implement separately.
checklist.evidence: The repository has no logic: `git ls-files | grep -vxE 'AGENTS.md|LICENSE|README.md'` gives no output, exit 1. Only the one-line agent description is duplicated (agent README.md:2, meta README.md:23, meta docs/architecture.md:13), and the copies differ (finding 1, note N5).

checklist.item: Dead code. Exports that nothing imports and files that nothing reaches, found with grep and tsc.
checklist.evidence: There are no exports, modules or source files (`git ls-files` lists AGENTS.md, LICENSE, README.md only). tsc has no project to check (no tsconfig.json; `bunx --no-install tsc --noEmit` prints its usage, exit 1).

checklist.item: Test quality. Coverage from the repository's own test script where it reports it; risky branches without a test; tests that assert nothing or only mirror the implementation.
checklist.evidence: No test script and no tests: `bun run test` exit 1 ('a package.json script "test" was not found'), `npm run test` exit 254, `cargo test` exit 101 (no Cargo.toml). No coverage is reported. There is no code, so there is no branch.

checklist.item: Error handling. Swallowed errors (empty or log-only catch, ignored promise rejections) and error shapes that differ for the same kind of failure.
checklist.evidence: No code, so no catch, promise, Result, unwrap or error type. #836 requires that a failed send is logged and retried on the next interval; the next audit after #836 lands should check this (note N7).

checklist.item: Consistency. Deviations from the repository's AGENTS.md and from the other services: naming, module layout, configuration handling.
checklist.evidence: Compared with the ten other targets: `grep -c '^@AGENTS.md$' <repo>/CLAUDE.md` gives 1 for api, config, console, contract, deploy, kit, notify, probe, status, website, and 'no file' for agent (finding 2, a noncandidate consistency note; spec #927 plan.md:503-504 explicitly excluded adding CLAUDE.md). `grep -n "^## Commands" */AGENTS.md`: 10 hits, none in agent (AGENTS.md has 9 lines and one section, the others 73-141 lines; note N1). No .github/ and no docs/development.md, consistent with meta docs/releasing.md:17,71 (note N2). AGENTS.md:9 (pure parsing, I/O at the edge) matches api/AGENTS.md:52, deploy/AGENTS.md:34 and code-conventions rule 3. No code or configuration to compare for naming and configuration handling.

checklist.item: Docs against code. Claims in the README and docs/ of this repository that the code does not match, each with the claim and the contradicting code.
checklist.evidence: No docs/ directory. README.md:2 claims a Rust agent that pushes CPU, memory, swap, disk and network values to pulse-api for host checks. There is no source file (`git ls-files | grep -vxE 'AGENTS.md|LICENSE|README.md'` exit 1), pulse-contract has the check types http, tls, tcp, dns, domain, heartbeat only (src/schema.ts:273-480, src/validate.ts:138), and pulse-api has no host sample route (`grep -rlniE 'hostSample|host ?sample|"host"' src --include=*.ts --exclude='*.test.ts'` exit 1). Finding 1. AGENTS.md:5,9 also refer to a crate that does not exist yet (part of finding 1). LICENSE is MIT, as #836 requires.

The comparison proves a missing import, not a build that ignored AGENTS.md or broke documented behavior. No such failure was reproduced. The owner can consider the standard import when #836 sets up the crate.

notes: N1 (consistency): AGENTS.md names no check command or done gate; spec #927 plan.md:29-30 relies on the gate each AGENTS.md names. #836 asks for rustfmt, clippy with warnings as errors, and tests in CI; a ## Commands section with them belongs in that change.

N2 (consistency): no CI workflow and no docs/development.md, consistent with meta docs/releasing.md:17,71. api, probe, notify, status and console have docs/development.md; contract, kit, config, deploy and website do not.

N3 (meta, audit template): .github/audits/quality.md names package.json scripts, biome, SonarJS, tsc and the shared configuration of pulse-config, targeting JavaScript and TypeScript rather than Rust; pulse-config has no Rust configuration (grep exit 1). Once #836 lands, the general checklist still applies, but the named commands need Rust equivalents (cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy with warnings as errors, cargo test). Coverage reporting and a complexity budget need separate decisions; cargo test alone does not report coverage.

N4 (meta, rotation): .github/audits/open-issue.sh:43 (security) and :54 (quality) include agent, the performance rotation (:47) does not. agent main has not changed since 2026-11-09; security audits #952 and #981 and this audit all examine 8e48f5c, which has no code. Leaving agent out of these rotations until #836 lands would save the runs.
N5 (docs duplication): the agent description is in agent README.md:2, meta README.md:23 and meta docs/architecture.md:13; only the two meta copies say 'planned' and 'no code yet' (finding 1).

N6 (not agent-specific, style): LICENSE:3 copyright holder is 'lorenzh' in agent, console, deploy, kit, website and 'Lorenz Hilpert' in api, config, contract, notify, probe, status; agent does not deviate from a single convention.

N7 (next audit): once #836 lands, check unwrap, expect and panics in the /proc and statfs parsers, that a failed send is logged and the loop continues, tests for counter wrap and reset in rate computation, the CI check of the sample against the pulse-contract JSON Schema, and no duplicate of the pulse-api threshold evaluation.
